create_StateMachineBasedWrapperEnv: create a StateMachineBasedWrapperEnv instance wrapping a LocomotionGymEnv with default toe positions and gait parameters
run_step_StateMachineBasedWrapperEnv: run a single step on the wrapped quadruped environment with a 3D action array for COM and toe movement
reset_StateMachineBasedWrapperEnv: reset the state machine wrapper environment to the initial STEP_LEFT_FRONT_TOE state and default toe positions
review_GaitStateMachine: review the GaitStateMachine enum defining the four quadruped gait states for alternating leg stepping order
build_move_leg_IK: build inverse kinematics targets for moving a swing leg along an elliptical trajectory during the gait cycle
